MCP_environment.GROKBOT_DATE_MCP_ROOT: Explicit absolute shared owner-only broker directory; host and existing MCP service must see the SAME files. No default path and no corpus copy.
MCP_environment.GROKBOT_DATE_MCP_PUBLIC_KEY: Host Ed25519 PUBLIC key PEM; signing private key stays only with host adapter.
MCP_environment.GROKBOT_MCP_CLAIM_SECRET: Existing claim-signing secret; no new bearer permissions or alternative endpoint.

hostConfiguration.keyProvisioning: Future reviewed host operation only; this draft generated no real secrets, read no credentials and made no config changes.

returnEnvelope.phase: audit | repair | reaudit, exactly as admitted
returnEnvelope.result: Complete normal workflow result JSON including exact hashes and reviewer or author metadata. Transport validates binding only; full historical/coverage validation is host-only.

phaseInstructions: Human/operator supplies the phase instruction to an already active independent context through an actually available supported channel; no such sending channel was exercised or fabricated here. Date-mode resume always requires exact pre-admission; never use no-type resume to find date jobs because that remains extraction allocation.
identityLimit: As in current attachment workflow, context identity is an operator/worker attestation, not cryptographic proof of an upstream provider conversation. Host signs only known role assignments and excludes extractor/all retained repair IDs; transport rejects equal banned IDs, but cannot detect a dishonest claim of another upstream identity.
failureAndRecovery: Keep all admission, capture, result and signed host lifecycle-event files. Host-rejected results get a NEW admission on normal workflow retry; previous capture remains. Conflicting duplicate payloads are captured then rejected; identical duplicate results are idempotent.

Interrupted nonexpired jobs reopen the exact admission only when the same host ownership/context/packet guard succeeds. Expired or changed admissions fail with a reconciliation requirement; no silent replacement, fresh claim or deadline extension.

Do not delete state or steal a sticky worker to resolve an expiry. Host must deliberately reconcile ownership at an idle boundary; a live source edit is prohibited while its packet is admitted. Polling guard detection is bounded by pollMs, so fingerprint freezing remains mandatory.

No date capture alone approves a chapter. All aggregate source checks, repair application, production validation, fresh independent re-audit, report-currentness and canonical publication stay in existing reviewed host workflow.

Malformed or unowned routing requests are rejected before artifact capture. Every owned, valid-token date submission captures its supplied artifact before artifact validation; no raw bearer or claim token is logged.

testing.result: 19/19 offline tests pass; SDK protocol tested using in-memory transport, no HTTP or credentials.
testing.limits: Host hook uses explicit fixture module stubs in its test. Actual production host date guards were inspected but not executed or modified.

adoption: Independent host review required. Do not apply over active jobs or older unrelated edits. Compare patch against actual canonical MCP baseline, preserve latest reviewed date guards, then run normal MCP/date-worker/workflow offline tests. Deploy/restart only at a separately authorized idle boundary after review. This task performed no adoption.
actionsNotTaken: No Git mutations, runtime edits, service restart/deployment, inference, queue/lease/lock/state changes, real credential access, Cursor SDK calls or computer use. All files are inside the unique draft artifact directory; retained test runs contain fake local evidence only.
